title: UW Markdown Section Block (format 2.0)
description: JSON envelope inside a fenced ```json uw:section=... block in a uw_version 2.0 file (RFC 0009). The nested _meta shape: provenance / quality / lifecycle / integrity sub-objects, with per-field exceptions lifted to the block-level _overrides annotation. Mirrors UWMetaV2 in @uwmd/core/meta-shape.ts. v1.x blocks are governed by uwmd-block.schema.json; a file's uw_version decides the shape for every block in it (META-V2-IN-V1 / META-V1-IN-V2).

section_id.description: Section identifier. Standard sections use the IDs registered in UW_FORMAT_SPEC_v1.md §4 (incorporated by reference into v2). Extension sections MUST start with 'x_'.

_overrides.description: Per-field exceptions to the block-level metadata (UW_FORMAT_SPEC_v2.md §3). Replaces v1 _meta.field_overrides; same entry shape, same precedence rule (an override wins for the paths it covers). Block content for integrity purposes — inside the digest.

path.description: Dot-notated path relative to the block content root (e.g. 'units[7].current_rent').

source.description: Actor override for this field (RFC 0031 actor grammar).

content.description: Section payload. Schema is per-section (UW_FORMAT_SPEC_v1.md §4.x, incorporated by reference). For extension sections (x_*) the content is unrestricted.

_notes.description: Free-text annotation. Never validated, never consumed by agents.

ResolutionTagV2.description: The 2.0 resolution vocabulary (UW_FORMAT_SPEC_v2.md §4.1). 'manual' left the vocabulary at 2.0 (RFC 0009 resolved question 4): it is actor-only, and 'user_input' is the resolution-method spelling for human-typed values. resolution: 'manual' in a 2.0 file is SRC-03.

section.description: MUST match the outer section_id. 2.0 writers emit the 'section' spelling; readers also accept 'section_id' as an alias (UW_FORMAT_SPEC_v2.md §2.1).

section_id.description: Accepted alias of 'section' (the dominant v1 on-disk spelling).

source.description: The actor (RFC 0031 grammar): 'manual' or '<namespace>/<id>' with a registered namespace. At 2.0 the grammar is enforced — a resolution tag here is SRC-02 (error), any other out-of-grammar value SRC-01 (error). UW_FORMAT_SPEC_v2.md §4.2.

actor.description: The principal that initiated the write. Distinct from source: source is the policy-vocabulary identity of the writer, actor is who asked for the write.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp at write time.

partial.description: True when at least one field inside the block is missing or unknown. When true, the block-level _overrides SHOULD enumerate which paths and why.

provisional.description: True when the entire block is a placeholder derived from defaults rather than observed data. Stronger than confidence: 'low'.

not.description: field_overrides left _meta at 2.0 — per-field exceptions live in the block-level _overrides annotation.

revision.description: 1-based supersede-chain position. Renamed from v1 'version' to end the collision with frontmatter uw_version (RFC 0009 resolved question 1); semantics unchanged.

superseded.description: True on every block that is not the chain head.

integrity.description: Cryptographic / structural verification. The whole sub-object is optional: integrity remains opt-in.

algorithm.description: Absent means 'sha256'; 'sha256' is the only admitted value at 2.0 (RFC 0009 resolved question 2). A defaulted value is excluded from the block digest; a non-default value is hashed and cannot be stripped undetected.

content_hash.description: sha256 of the canonicalization-v2 form (normalize-then-hash; UW_PROTOCOL_v1.md §V.9).

parent_hash.description: content_hash of the superseded predecessor; null on a chain root.

signature.description: Detached signature over the block's signing input (protocol §V.11, RFC 0010) — same wire shape as v1, relocated under integrity. Requires content_hash (INT-05).
